title: TechnoAi and Keenon Robotics Join Forces to Revolutionize Hospitality and Logistics Automation in the Middle East - TechnoAi
description: TechnoAi partners with Keenon Robotics to bring advanced service and delivery robots to the Middle East and Africa — transforming hospitality and logistics with intelligent automation and AI-driven efficiency.

hero.title: TechnoAi and Keenon Robotics Join Forces to Revolutionize Hospitality and Logistics Automation in the Middle East

blocks.html: TechnoAi partners with Keenon Robotics to bring advanced service and delivery robots to the Middle East and Africa — transforming hospitality and logistics with intelligent automation and AI-driven efficiency.
TechnoAi, the UAE’s gateway to intelligent automation and AI solutions, has officially partnered with Keenon Robotics, a global leader in service and hospitality robotics.
This collaboration marks a major step forward in bringing robotic automation, operational efficiency, and smart service to the hospitality and logistics sectors across the Middle East and Africa.
A Partnership That Redefines Efficiency

Under this alliance, TechnoAi becomes the authorized regional partner for Keenon Robotics — offering its full suite of AI-driven delivery, reception, and cleaning robots to hotels, restaurants, offices, and logistics operations throughout the region.

Keenon’s robots are transforming how hospitality and logistics operate worldwide,” said Ahmed Bakr, “and through this partnership, TechnoAi will ensure that businesses in the Middle East can access the same level of innovation — supported locally with seamless installation, training, and maintenance.
The partnership strengthens TechnoAi’s mission to bridge cutting-edge global technologies with regional needs, making service robotics practical, reliable, and ROI-driven for all types of operations.
Image credit: Keenon
Image credit:
Keenon
Transforming the Hospitality Experience
Keenon’s robotics lineup includes a diverse portfolio of service robots tailored for front-of-house and back-of-house tasks:

items: Butlerbot W3 – Greets and guides guests from lobbies to rooms or conference halls.
Dinerbot T10 / T9 / T8 / T3 – Delivers meals and beverages to tables with precision and charm.
Keenon T9 Pro – Optimized for high-traffic restaurants, capable of smart obstacle avoidance and efficient multi-table service.
Keenon S100 – Handles heavy loads, making hotel and event logistics smoother than ever.
Keenon C40 & C20 – Cleaning robots for large or compact spaces, ensuring spotless environments.

blocks.html: These robots not only enhance guest experience but also reduce staff workload, increase productivity, and ensure consistent service quality — all key priorities for modern hospitality operations.
Automation in Logistics and Smart Facilities

Beyond hotels and restaurants, the collaboration extends into logistics centers, corporate buildings, and healthcare facilities.
Keenon’s autonomous robots can navigate complex environments, handle repetitive delivery tasks, and provide 24/7 operational continuity — improving both speed and safety.

By integrating Keenon’s robotics ecosystem with TechnoAi’s AI and connectivity solutions (including drones and satellite communications), clients can achieve fully connected smart operations — from automated delivery to real-time monitoring.

Our joint solutions deliver measurable results — faster service, lower operating costs, and improved staff satisfaction,” added Lucas Zhu.
TechnoAi’s technical capability and regional expertise make them the perfect partner for scaling Keenon’s technology across the Middle East.
Serving the Middle East & Africa with Local Support
TechnoAi provides end-to-end support, including:

items: Delivery and installation of robotic systems
Maintenance, software updates, and lifecycle support

blocks.html: With a Dubai-based technical team and an expanding partner network across the GCC, TechnoAi ensures fast response times and reliable post-deployment support.
Empowering the Future of Smart Service

The TechnoAi × Keenon Robotics partnership aligns with the UAE’s and region’s growing focus on smart cities, digital transformation, and AI-powered automation.
Together, the companies aim to empower businesses to embrace a future where robots and humans collaborate seamlessly to deliver smarter, safer, and more efficient services.

This partnership is not just about robots,” noted Ahmed Bakr.
It’s about redefining how businesses think about efficiency, sustainability, and guest satisfaction.
About TechnoAi

TechnoAi is a UAE-based technology integrator specializing in AI systems, drones, robotics, and satellite communications.
Through global partnerships, TechnoAi enables industries to operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently.
